content.title: Red-Blade Resolve | Gaze Trigger, Battlefield Charge and Energy Finish
content.summary: An adult ash-field guardian turns one red blade residue into a controlled energy arc. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult warrior, blade and field persist. + One red accent family carries every activation stage. + The gaze change precedes forward action. + Exactly one principal sword cut occurs. + The final stance is readable without inventing casualties or victory.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original adult ash-field guardian behind a blade carrying one narrow red residue line. Keep adult opponent silhouettes on both sides while dust and loose fragments increase without hiding the route. End with the same guardian in a stable low stance, blade visible and three red residual streaks fading behind; show no declared victory.
required_anchors: One clearly adult warrior, blade and field persist.
One red accent family carries every activation stage.
Exactly one principal sword cut occurs.
The final stance is readable without inventing casualties or victory.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult ash-field guardian turns one red blade residue into a controlled energy arc. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 以黑白战场、同一成年武士和带血刀锋建立低谷基线；人物抬眼后沿同一轴线冲入敌阵，刀刃红光从细线升级为大面积能量轨迹，终局英雄姿态保持可读且不宣称具体战果。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult warrior, blade and field persist.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult warrior, blade and field persist."

invariants.rule: One red accent family carries every activation stage.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "One red accent family carries every activation stage."

invariants.rule: The gaze change precedes forward action.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The gaze change precedes forward action."

invariants.rule: Exactly one principal sword cut occurs.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Exactly one principal sword cut occurs."

invariants.rule: The final stance is readable without inventing casualties or victory.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final stance is readable without inventing casualties or victory."

the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
